title: Scallywag Air
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Take to the skies in retro flying cap and goggles, as you explore Galveston Island from the air.

quotes.text: The pilot was professional and friendly. I am a pilot as well, and felt immediately at ease regarding safety and competence. I got an outstanding aerial tour of Galveston with some bonus time over highlights like Seawolf Park and the Battleship Texas. It’s well worth it!

My pilot Cadence was amazing and so was the smooth ride in the sky that she delivered on my journey in my first ever Biplane experience!!! The views from the biplane were stunning, especially over coastlines, beaches and the port where i saw my Carnival Cruise Ship.

What an amazing experience!! She was such a pleasure to be around and fly with!! It’s so wonderful to see someone her age out there making her dreams come true!! Our flight was perfect! We called to check times, and were in the air less than 2 hours later! ❤️‍🔥

This was one of the best experiences i have ever had (and I'm old). Nathan was not only very friendly, he was patient with me and my conditions, I am 6'5" and have both ankles in a cast. He walked me through getting in and out. It was so so nice!!! He ROCKS!!!!

A picture perfect day. Sara gave us a run down on what to expect, helped us get buckled in and we were up, up and away. Amazing beauty to behold from the air. Very smooth ride and no bumps or drops. We highly recommend this unforgettable lifetime experience!

Our pilot Sarah was amazing!!! Multiple thumbs up! Great personality! Def will be back for another ride around Galveston. Super smooth ride plus landing was amazing! If I could give more stars definitely would. This is a must “do” experience on the island.
